page.layout: One page of text, centred verse block at top, then a dedication in two lines and a signature line; below them a woodcut vignette; catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: MARTE feros meditetur hostes Pulsare iusto: seu PATRIÆ bonas Seruare paces cogitet, & suos Ditare subiectos verendus Iustitia moderante PRINCEPS. Cui sacra dono, DUX BONE, si faues Lamenta HEBRÆO carmine quæ prius MYSTES Ionauit. Sacra non sunt Consiliis nocitura rectis.

page.notes: Woodcut vignette below the signature (a cherub's head flanked by fruit-garlands and scrolls) is an ornament, not text, and is not transcribed. Faint mirrored text at the right edge is show-through and is omitted. Spelling changed per the u/v and i/j rule: "Dvx" read as DUX, "Iustitia"/"iusto" as Justitia/justo, "seruare" as servare, "Ionauit" as Jonavit, "faues" as faves, "Consilijs" as Consiliis, "Iacomotus" as Jacomotus; the printed spellings are the originals. Verse lines are kept as one paragraph per stanza, with line breaks.
